name: kooz-bot
author: Abdulrahman Boudi
description: A deep-search Hybrid on nets trained from scratch: it imagines 64 hidden deals from its guess net, searches every legal card, and only Dash Calls when the bid net rates the Dash Call +10 or better.
method: the bid net picks the bid; a Dash Call only if it is worth +10 or more
imagine hidden hands from the guess net, keep those that fit the bids x64
each legal card: the card net plays all 4 seats to the end
